forge_section.body: Every campaign begins with the list. Every list is forged in iron and resolve. Here we record each tournament, each round, and every triumph and fall — so that the players of the Old World may stand on the Leaderboard, their deeds sealed in stone.

musters.empty_title: No live tournaments at the moment.
musters.empty_body: When a tournament goes live, it will be listed here.

roll_of_honour.heading: Leaderboard
roll_of_honour.empty_body: The forge awaits its first strike.

swiss.title: Swiss Rounds
swiss.body: Every player plays a fixed number of rounds, paired against opponents of equal standing. No one is eliminated; the standings decide.

bracket.title: Brackets
bracket.body: Single- and double-elimination brackets. Each match carves the bracket tree, until only one banner remains.

draft.title: The Draft
draft.body: Live Captain's Mode draft. Players claim and forbid factions in real time — the draft is the first battle.

sigillum.heading: Join the Realm
sigillum.subline: Every list, every triumph, every fall — eternal.

login.title: Sign In
login.subtitle: Sign in with your Discord account to enter tournaments or create your own.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty_body: Once the first players leave their mark, the standings appear here.

create.title: Create Tournament
create.subtitle: Create a new tournament for the RizzOtto's Arena community.
create.role_warning: You need the Organizer role to create tournaments. Contact an administrator to upgrade your role.

aside.heading: What is a Tournament?
aside.body: A tournament brings players together to compete. You define the format, mode, and rules — others sign up and play.
aside.bullet_format: The format sets the bracket structure — Single Elimination, Swiss or Round Robin.
aside.bullet_mode: The mode sets the match size — 1v1 or team encounters.
aside.bullet_draft: Optional: Enable the draft system for live picks with real-time streaming.
aside.footnote: You can edit every field after the tournament has been created.
